clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he put it out to the universe: he wanted $50,000 a week without working for it.

A month later in New York City, at a shared table at the Carnegie Deli, he recognizes the stranger next to him - Bobby Singer, who sold the blackjack method on TV. Bobby offers to fund and produce an infomercial for his memory course.

Kevin Trudeau says he went back to his hotel, checked his voicemail, and heard the exact same offer from a totally different friend, Ed Beckley.

Two strangers, the same week, out of nowhere, with the same idea.

Do you believe in coincidence, or is the universe actually listening?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #yourwishisyourcommand #lawofattraction #mindset #synchronicity
clips.send: Someone mid-manifesting sends it to a doubting friend: awe - two strangers offered him the exact same thing in the same week, unprompted.
